quotes.text: “If Thou Wilt Enter into Life, Keep the Commandments” By Elder Robert D. Hales Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles The Savior said, “If thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments” ( Matt. 19:17 ). I would like to tell you a story, brethren—a true story about a man named Abinadi. Abinadi was a

The king was more wroth] Truly, as Nephi said, "the guilty taketh the truth to be hard, for it cutteth them to the very center" (1 Nephi 16:2). In the eyes of King Noah, Alma simply added insult to injury: not only had Abinadi delivered a message which tore away his facade and threatened to destroy his craft, but he had gained a convert in the process, another who now sought to give truth a fair hearing.
quotes.source: Doctrinal Commentary on the Book of Mormon
quotes.attr: Joseph Fielding Mc Conkie and Robert L. Millet, Doctrinal Commentary on the Book of Mormon, 4 vols., 2:, p.249

quotes.text: King Noah caused Alma to be cast out, and sent his servants after him for to slay him, because he pleaded for the prophet Abinadi. But Alma escaped. Page 179.
